parameters.name: method
parameters.description: the API method to be called

parameters.name: http_conn_id
parameters.description: http connection id that has the base API url i.e https://www.google.com/ and optional authentication credentials. Default headers can also be specified in the Extra field in json format.

parameters.name: auth_type
parameters.description: The auth type for the service

parameters.name: api_version
parameters.description: api version to use

parameters.name: integration_key
parameters.description: PagerDuty Events API token

parameters.name: pagerduty_events_conn_id
parameters.description: connection that has PagerDuty integration key in the Pagerduty API token field

parameters.name: summary
parameters.description: Summary for the event

parameters.name: severity
parameters.description: Severity for the event, needs to be one of: info, warning, error, critical

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Specific human-readable unique identifier, such as a hostname, for the system having the problem.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Event action, needs to be one of: trigger, acknowledge, resolve. Default to trigger if not specified.

parameters.name: dedup_key
parameters.description: A string which identifies the alert triggered for the given event. Required for the actions acknowledge and resolve.

parameters.name: custom_details
parameters.description: Free-form details from the event. Can be a dictionary or a string. If a dictionary is passed it will show up in PagerDuty as a table.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: A cluster or grouping of sources. For example, sources "prod-datapipe-02" and "prod-datapipe-03" might both be part of "prod-datapipe"

parameters.name: component
parameters.description: The part or component of the affected system that is broken.

parameters.name: class_type
parameters.description: The class/type of the event.

parameters.name: images
parameters.description: List of images to include. Each dictionary in the list accepts the following keys: `src`: The source (URL) of the image being attached to the incident. This image must be served via HTTPS. `href`: [Optional] URL to make the image a clickable link. `alt`: [Optional] Alternative text for the image.

parameters.name: links
parameters.description: List of links to include. Each dictionary in the list accepts the following keys: `href`: URL of the link to be attached. `text`: [Optional] Plain text that describes the purpose of the link, and can be used as the link's text.
